name: Drizzle Gateway
description: Drizzle Studio on your own server: a browser database explorer for PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, LibSQL and more, behind one master password, with the saved connections on its volume. It reaches databases over the network, so a database on this host must be reachable from its container.

access.note: The gateway asks for one master password and no account name: the generated MASTERPASS from the Variables tab is the whole credential, and it also encrypts the saved connections. Changing it later makes those connections unreadable.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Public domain
inputs.description: Optional; the address the studio is opened at; nothing else here changes when it does.

ports.name: http
ports.purpose: Drizzle Studio and the API it calls

volumes.name: data
volumes.purpose: Saved database connections, encrypted with the master password

secrets.name: masterpass
secrets.label: Master password
secrets.description: Unlocks the studio and encrypts the saved connections.
